hypothesis: An evaluator-first contract that freezes semantics, relative phase, ancilla cleanup and failure budget can prevent invalid reversible-circuit resource comparisons and support a falsifiable Pareto search.
expected_gain: Better correctness/provenance and resource-comparison discipline; quantitative gain is unknown until a representative circuit is generated and independently evaluated.
resource_dimensions: peak logical qubits including live ancillas
non_cost_proxy: Toffoli_count * peak_qubits is descriptive only; it is not total cost or accepted-task economics.
acceptance_gates: Identical function specification and SHA-256 across candidates
Distinct generator and evaluator roles with pinned hashes
Complete basis-state verification or proof artifact with explicit assumptions
Same allowed failure budget and supported input domain
Pareto comparison across multiple resource dimensions
Target-aware simulation and provider-neutral lowering only after logical acceptance
End-to-end accepted useful-task cost against a competitive CPU/GPU/NPU baseline
